## Context
This workstream has 23 leaves and 242 distinct file-impact paths across interface, script, integration, external, and end-to-end tests. Of those paths, 232 map to the retired per-file audit; 10 were added without a retired-source mapping. This story makes no repository edits.

## Plan
- Complete all 23 leaves using their exact Scope and file-impact manifests.
- Each leaf edits only allowlisted prose, preserves behavior-bearing text, runs its recorded checks, and obtains its required non-author semantic-review TSV.
- At story completion, derive two sorted TSVs from the live children and their net-active `replacement -supersedes-> retired source` links.
- Migration TSV (232 rows): `path<TAB>replacement-leaf-alias<TAB>source-ticket-alias<TAB>scope-count<TAB>file-impact-count`.
- Execution TSV (242 rows): `path<TAB>replacement-leaf-alias<TAB>scope-count<TAB>file-impact-count<TAB>source-count`. A source count of zero is valid only for the 10 added paths.
- Store both TSVs in a dedicated `session_log` linked `relates_to` this story. Record each row count and SHA-256 in the completion comment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 23 child leaves are closed.
- [ ] The migration TSV contains exactly 232 rows.
- [ ] The migration TSV contains exactly 232 distinct audited paths.
- [ ] The migration TSV contains exactly 232 distinct retired source tickets.
- [ ] Every retired source ticket has exactly one live replacement leaf.
- [ ] Every migration row has `scope-count=1`.
- [ ] Every migration row has `file-impact-count=1`.
- [ ] The execution TSV contains exactly 242 rows.
- [ ] The execution TSV contains exactly 242 distinct paths.
- [ ] Every execution row has `scope-count=1`.
- [ ] Every execution row has `file-impact-count=1`.
- [ ] Exactly 232 execution rows have `source-count=1`.
- [ ] Exactly 10 execution rows have `source-count=0`.
- [ ] Every migrated Scope constraint has a non-author `semantic-preservation=PASS` row with immutable before/final citations.
- [ ] Every migrated consumer contract has a non-author `semantic-preservation=PASS` row with immutable before/final citations.
- [ ] Every edited prose block has a non-author `bloat-removal=PASS` row.
- [ ] Every recorded leaf verification command exits 0 at its cited commit.
- [ ] The story log records each leaf commit, command result, and reviewer-log id.
- [ ] The completion comment cites the story session-log id.
- [ ] The completion comment records both row counts and both TSV SHA-256 values.

## Completion boundary
Close this story only after every child is closed and both inventories pass these checks.
